title: Regression Known Broken With Evidence
purpose: Validate that fragmented bug reports bind to an existing capability as a known-broken regression with evidence, not as a new feature or UI fallback request.
expectedFinalIntent: Record chat list loading as an existing capability regression, preserve the query-failure clue as unverified evidence, and require investigation before implementation.

userFragments.content: The chat list opened yesterday, but today it is blank.
I am not sure if it is login, but the log looks like a collection query failed.
Do not refactor yet. Treat it as a regression and do not hide it with a UI fallback.

secretaryReplies.content: Classified as a bug or regression against the existing chat list capability, not a new feature request.
The collection query failure is evidence to preserve, but it is not yet a confirmed root cause.
The control record should require reproduction and diagnosis before implementation; UI fallback is explicitly out of scope.

requiredPhrases: collection query failure is a clue, not a confirmed root cause
Do not add a UI fallback
forbiddenPhrases: Add UI fallback to hide query failure
